data.title: Visualize a robot arm's sampled reach
data.summary: A licensed MuJoCo arm model, joint limits and 100 sampled configurations. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: MuJoCo simulates articulated structures interacting through contact.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / MuJoCo environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A licensed MuJoCo arm model, joint limits and 100 sampled configurations.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent robot reach workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A licensed MuJoCo arm model, joint limits and 100 sampled configurations. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Load the existing model and inspect joint axes, limits and link units
Sample configurations inside limits and record end-effector positions
Visualize the points in Blender or a web viewer while preserving solver coordinates

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned visualize a robot arm's sampled reach candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Every sample stays within the declared joint limits
A known reference pose maps to the expected endpoint
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Kinematic reach does not prove collision-free paths, payload or real robot safety.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Treat a sampled cloud as a lower-coverage illustration, not the full reachable volume.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me visualize a robot arm's sampled reach in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A licensed MuJoCo arm model, joint limits and 100 sampled configurations. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Every sample stays within the declared joint limits; A known reference pose maps to the expected endpoint. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
